author: bardic-inspiration
name: Sapsong Cicadas
summary: A cloud of fat, amber-winged cicadas whose droning song pulls the mind toward sleep.
description: In the hottest part of a forest summer, sapsong cicadas rise from the root-mud in a single night and drone until the first rain. Bark-gatherers stuff their ears with wax and work in pairs, one to cut and one to watch the other.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.text: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain {ref:glossary/hit-points} or gain {ref:glossary/temporary-hit-points}.

actions.name: Bites
actions.onHit: The attack deals half damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

actions.name: Drowsing Drone

save.targets: each creature within 20 feet of the swarm that can hear it

actions.onFailure: The target's Speed is halved, and it has {ref:glossary/disadvantage} on Dexterity saving throws until the end of the swarm's next turn. If the target fails by 5 or more, it has the {ref:condition/incapacitated} condition until the end of the swarm's next turn instead.
